```bash

import json, pathlib

    en = locs.get('en', {}).get('stringUnit', {}).get('value')
    print(f"KEY: {key}\nEN : {en}\n---")

"""
for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        key, fr, es = line.split("|", 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    translations[key] = {"fr": fr.replace("\\n", "\n"), "es": es.replace("\\n", "\n")}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    # Allow potential extra only for empty handled above? But keep as guard
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault("localizations", {})
    for lang in ("fr", "es"):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            "stringUnit": {
                "state": "translated",
                "value": value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print("Updated", len(strings), "keys with fr/es translations.")

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        key, fr, es = line.split("|", 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    translations[key] = {"fr": fr.replace("\\n", "\n"), "es": es.replace("\\n", "\n")}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    # Allow potential extra only for empty handled above? But keep as guard
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault("localizations", {})
    for lang in ("fr", "es"):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            "stringUnit": {
                "state": "translated",
                "value": value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print("Updated", len(strings), "keys with fr/es translations.")

"""
for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, fr, es = line.split("|", 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace("\\n", "\n")
    translations[key] = {"fr": fr.replace("\\n", "\n"), "es": es.replace("\\n", "\n")}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault("localizations", {})
    for lang in ("fr", "es"):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            "stringUnit": {
                "state": "translated",

            }

"""
for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, fr, es = line.split("|", 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace("\\n", "\n")
    translations[key] = {"fr": fr.replace("\\n", "\n"), "es": es.replace("\\n", "\n")}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault("localizations", {})
    for lang in ("fr", "es"):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            "stringUnit": {
                "state": "translated",
                "value": value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print("Updated", len(strings), "keys with fr/es translations.")
PY

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, zh = line.split('|', 1)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace('\\n', '\n')
    translations[key] = zh.replace('\\n', '\n')

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    value = translations[key]
    locs['zh-Hans'] = {
        'stringUnit': {
            'state': 'translated',
            'value': value,
        }
    }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated zh-Hans for', len(strings), 'keys.')

    translations[key] = zh.replace('\\n', '\n')

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    value = translations[key]
    locs['zh-Hans'] = {
        'stringUnit': {
            'state': 'translated',
            'value': value,
        }
    }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated zh-Hans for', len(strings), 'keys.')
PY

"""

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, nl, da = line.split('|', 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace('\\n', '\n')
    translations[key] = {"nl": nl.replace('\\n', '\n'), "da": da.replace('\\n', '\n')}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    for lang in ('nl', 'da'):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            'stringUnit': {
                'state': 'translated',
                'value': value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated nl/da for', len(strings), 'keys.')

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, nl, da = line.split('|', 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace('\\n', '\n')
    translations[key] = {"nl": nl.replace('\\n', '\n'), "da": da.replace('\\n', '\n')}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    for lang in ('nl', 'da'):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            'stringUnit': {
                'state': 'translated',
                'value': value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated nl/da for', len(strings), 'keys.')

"""

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, fi_val, it_val = line.split('|', 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace('\\n', '\n')
    translations[key] = {"fi": fi_val.replace('\\n', '\n'), "it": it_val.replace('\\n', '\n')}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    for lang in ('fi', 'it'):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            'stringUnit': {
                'state': 'translated',
                'value': value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated fi/it for', len(strings), 'keys.')

"""

for line in textwrap.dedent(translations_text).strip().splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    try:
        raw_key, fi_val, it_val = line.split('|', 2)
    except ValueError:
        raise SystemExit(f"Bad line: {line!r}")
    key = raw_key.replace('\\n', '\n')
    translations[key] = {"fi": fi_val.replace('\\n', '\n'), "it": it_val.replace('\\n', '\n')}

missing = set(strings.keys()) - set(translations.keys())
extra = set(translations.keys()) - set(strings.keys())
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"Missing translations for keys: {sorted(missing)}")
if extra:
    raise SystemExit(f"Translations provided for unknown keys: {sorted(extra)[:5]}")

for key, entry in strings.items():
    locs = entry.setdefault('localizations', {})
    for lang in ('fi', 'it'):
        value = translations[key][lang]
        locs[lang] = {
            'stringUnit': {
                'state': 'translated',
                'value': value,
            }
        }

path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Updated fi/it for', len(strings), 'keys.')
